mapper.select: SELECT cr.id, cr.patient_id AS patient_id, d.name AS doctor_name, dept.name AS department_name, cr.ended_at AS completed_at, cr.updated_at FROM consult_record cr JOIN doctor d ON d.id = cr.doctor_id LEFT JOIN department dept ON dept.id = d.dept_id WHERE cr.patient_id = #{patientId} AND cr.status = 'COMPLETED' AND cr.doctor_note IS NOT NULL AND btrim(cr.doctor_note) <> '' AND cr.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY cr.ended_at DESC NULLS LAST, cr.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM consult_record cr WHERE cr.patient_id = #{patientId} AND cr.status = 'COMPLETED' AND cr.doctor_note IS NOT NULL AND btrim(cr.doctor_note) <> '' AND cr.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT cr.id, cr.patient_id AS patient_id, cr.doctor_id AS doctor_id, d.name AS doctor_name, dept.name AS department_name, cr.doctor_note, cr.started_at, cr.ended_at AS completed_at, cr.updated_at FROM consult_record cr JOIN doctor d ON d.id = cr.doctor_id LEFT JOIN department dept ON dept.id = d.dept_id WHERE cr.id = #{reportId} AND cr.status = 'COMPLETED' AND cr.doctor_note IS NOT NULL AND btrim(cr.doctor_note) <> '' AND cr.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT r.id, r.report_name, r.report_date, COUNT(i.id) AS indicator_count FROM patient_report r LEFT JOIN patient_report_indicator i ON i.report_id = r.id WHERE r.patient_id = #{patientId} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY r.id, r.report_name, r.report_date ORDER BY r.report_date DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM patient_report WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT id, patient_id, report_name, report_date, interpretation_status, interpretation::text AS interpretation FROM patient_report WHERE id = #{reportId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT name, value, unit, reference_range FROM patient_report_indicator WHERE report_id = #{reportId} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT id, patient_id, drug_name_snapshot AS drug_name, dosage, frequency, next_remind_at, status FROM medication_plan WHERE id = #{planId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT id, patient_id, follow_up_type AS type, due_at, content, status, remind_at FROM follow_up_plan WHERE id = #{followUpId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
